stem: A TV promotion ran during Black Week. Soundbar sales rose 40% against their baseline, and laptops, which have no link to TVs, rose 35% in the same weeks. What is the soundest reading of the soundbar rise?

options.text: It is the TV deal's halo, since soundbars are the TVs' linked category
Much of it may be Black Week demand, so the deal's own halo is unclear
Laptops gained a halo from the TV deal as well, so both rises count
The rise proves a halo, because it happened in the same weeks as the deal
